test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a row of 12 students, when Karan was shifted by three places towards the right, he became fifth from the right end. What was his earlier position from the left end?
solution:
• In a row of 12 students, Karan's new position = 5th from the right end
 
• Therefore, Karan's new position from the left = 12 - 5 + 1 = 8th from the left end
 
• Karan's earlier position from the left = Karan's new position from the left - 3 = 8 - 3 = 5th from the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e31ef2c019bd9cf815f433de4ce59ecf6b4beda368bb812054507087f330d7d6.png] 

Hence, **"Fifth"** is the correct answer.
